originalTitle: 3 Reasons to Sell MKL and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: Over the past six months, Markel Group’s shares (currently trading at $1,842) have posted a disappointing 11.5% loss, well below the S&P 500’s 13.5% gain. This was partly driven by its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.
content:
Over the past six months, Markel Group's shares (currently trading at $1,842) have posted a disappointing 11.5% loss, well below the S&P 500's 13.5% gain. This was partly driven by its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.

Is there a buying opportunity in Markel Group, or does it present a risk to your portfolio? Get the full stock story straight from our expert analysts, it's free .

Even with the cheaper entry price, we're cautious about Markel Group. Here are three reasons why there are better opportunities than MKL, plus one stock we'd rather own.

1. Net Premiums Earned Hit a Plateau

Net premiums earned are net of what's paid to reinsurers (insurance for insurance companies), which are used by insurers to protect themselves from large losses.

Markel Group's net premiums earned was flat over the last two years, much worse than the broader insurance industry. This shows that policy underwriting underperformed its other business lines.

2. Revenue Projections Show Stormy Skies Ahead

Forecasted revenues by Wall Street analysts signal a company's potential. Predictions may not always be accurate, but accelerating growth typically boosts valuation multiples and stock prices while slowing growth does the opposite.

Over the next 12 months, sell-side analysts expect Markel Group's revenue to drop by 1.6%, a decrease from its 2.6% annualized growth for the past two years. This projection is underwhelming and implies its products and services will face some demand challenges.

Markel Group isn't a terrible business, but it doesn't pass our bar. After the recent drawdown, the stock trades at 1.1× forward P/B (or $1,842 per share). Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, but our analysis shows the upside isn't great compared to the potential downside. We're fairly confident there are better investments elsewhere. We'd suggest looking at one of Charlie Munger's all-time favorite businesses .

chineseSummary: 在过去的六个月里，Markel Group 的股价（目前交易价格为 1,842 美元）令人失望地下跌了 11.5%，远低于标准普尔 500 指数 13.5% 的涨幅。这在一定程度上是由其疲软的季度业绩推动的，可能会让投资者考虑下一步行动。
chineseContent:
在过去六个月中，Markel Group 的股价（目前交易价格为 1,842 美元）令人失望地下跌了 11.5%，远低于标准普尔 500 指数 13.5% 的涨幅。这在一定程度上是由其疲软的季度业绩推动的，可能会让投资者考虑下一步行动。

Markel Group 是否存在买入机会，或者是否会给您的投资组合带来风险？直接从我们的专家分析师那里获取完整的股票故事，它是免费的。

即使入门价格更便宜，我们对马克尔集团仍持谨慎态度。以下是为什么有比 MKL 更好的机会的三个原因，以及我们宁愿持有的一只股票。

1. 净保费收入达到稳定水平

所赚取的净保费扣除了支付给再保险公司（保险公司的保险）的费用，保险公司用这些费用来保护自己免受巨额损失。

马克尔集团的净保费收入在过去两年中持平，比整个保险业要差得多。这表明保单承保的表现落后于其他业务线。

2. 收入预测显示未来风雨飘摇

华尔街分析师预测的收入表明了公司的潜力。预测可能并不总是准确的，但加速增长通常会推高估值倍数和股价，而放缓增长则相反。

卖方分析师预计，未来 12 个月，Markel Group 的收入将下降 1.6%，低于过去两年 2.6% 的年化增长率。这一预测并不令人印象深刻，意味着其产品和服务将面临一些需求挑战。

马克尔集团并不是一家糟糕的企业，但它没有通过我们的标准。在最近的下跌之后，该股的交易价格为 1.1 倍远期市净率（即每股 1,842 美元）。情人眼里出西施，但我们的分析显示，与潜在的缺点相比，其优点并不大。我们相当有信心其他地方有更好的投资。我们建议您关注查理芒格一直以来最喜欢的企业之一。

我们比马克尔集团更喜欢的股票

当您在这里时：排名前九的跑赢市场的股票。最好的股票不会只跑赢市场一次。他们又这么做了。又来了。强劲的收入增长、不断增长的自由现金流、资本回报率让他们在竞争中遥遥领先。市场已经给这些企业带来了回报。
